items.source: public interface Window<T> extends Streamable<T>
items.translation: public interface Window<T> extends Streamable<T>

items.source: A set of data consumed from an underlying query result. A Window is similar to Slice in the sense that it contains a subset of the actual query results for easier scrolling across large result sets. The window is less opinionated about the actual data retrieval, whether the query has used index/offset, keyset-based pagination or cursor resume tokens.
items.translation: 从底层查询结果中消费的一组数据。Window 与 Slice 类似，因为它包含实际查询结果的子集，以便于在大型结果集中进行滚动。该窗口对实际数据获取方式持较少的主张态度，无论查询是使用索引/偏移量、基于键集的分页还是游标恢复令牌进行的。

items.source:
Parameters:
index - index of the window element to determine the scroll position for.
Returns:
the scroll position for the given object index.
Throws:
IndexOutOfBoundsException - if the index is out of range (index < 0 || index >= size()).
IllegalStateException - if the underlying scroll mechanism cannot provide a scroll position for the given object.
items.translation:
参数：
index - 要确定滚动位置的窗口元素的索引。
返回：
给定对象索引的滚动位置。
抛出：
IndexOutOfBoundsException - 如果索引超出范围（index < 0 || index >= size()）。
IllegalStateException - 如果底层的滚动机制无法为给定的对象提供滚动位置。
